identification: Victorian chest of seven drawers (three short across top, small centre pair, three long), turned timber knobs (mixed), moulded top, on turned bun feet. Title says cedar with Huon pine secondaries, so probably Tasmanian colonial c1860-80. Damage to lower left corner. One drawer lined with later patterned paper. Photos show a darker, worn surface.

searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) with cedar chest drawers; cedar 7 drawer chest; huon pine secondaries chest; victorian seven drawer chest cedar. Generic Victorian furniture, so stopped early with no web search, per the rule for common furniture. Local results are all hammer prices, premium extra. Sound Victorian cedar chests about $200-450 at Gowans and Armitage; damaged or incomplete ones $140-240. Eight Gowans/Armitage comps, none opened as pages (database records).
viewing_check: Check the lower left corner damage (size, whether the veneer or carcase is split), confirm timber is cedar and the secondaries are Huon pine (look inside a drawer), check for original knobs and feet, and check the top for deep marks or splits.
